info.name: url.retail.publishedprices.co.il
info.description:
Cerberus web client shared by many chains; each chain is a user account.

Flow: `GET /login` (session cookie `cftpSID` + `csrftoken` meta tag) -> `POST /login/user` (redirects to `/file`, whose page has a new `csrftoken`) -> `POST /file/json/dir` (list files) -> `GET /file/d/{fileName}`.
Some accounts (e.g. Super Yuda) keep their files in a subfolder.
